remarks: Discover elevated West Hollywood living in this impeccably updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence, ideally positioned on one of the city's most sought-after, tree-lined streets. Blending modern sophistication with effortless comfort, this beautifully appointed second-floor condo offers a serene retreat just moments from West Hollywood's premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and nightlife. A light-filled, open-concept layout welcomes you inside, where a spacious living area with a stylish fireplace flows seamlessly to a private, covered balcony overlooking the lush courtyard and sparkling pool, an inviting setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or evening relaxation.
